profile.tagline: Performance Test Engineer for JMeter, Gatling and LoadRunner

summary.summary: Thirteen years in testing, ten of them focused on load and performance. Plans load scenarios, finds bottlenecks across application, database and infrastructure and builds performance gates into pipelines.

list.degree: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level and Performance Testing

list.details:
- Performance tests for the migration of SAP ECC to S/4HANA of a retail company, modules SD and MM
- LoadRunner scenarios for dialog users (up to 5,000 concurrent) and for batch runs
- Bottleneck analysis together with SAP Basis and the database team
- Planned the performance test phases with the test manager and reported results to the steering committee

- Gatling simulations in Scala and JMeter plans for REST APIs of the online banking platform
- Performance gates in Azure DevOps pipelines: a build fails when p95 exceeds the budget
- Monitoring with Grafana, Prometheus and Application Insights during test runs
- API tests for the performance-relevant endpoints

- JMeter and LoadRunner tests for billing and customer portals
- Test planning for load, stress and endurance tests
- Analysis with Dynatrace, recommendations to development and operations

- Functional testing of web applications, test cases and defect tracking
- SoapUI tests for web services, a few Selenium scripts
- First JMeter load tests for a booking system

list.title: Performance gate template for pipelines
list.tagline: A reusable pipeline template that runs a short Gatling test per build and compares p95 and error rate with a stored budget.

list.title: Capacity model for a booking system
list.tagline: A model from measured load tests that predicts response times for the expected peak of the holiday season.
